name: UNICEF GLOBAL MPOX PREPAREDNESS AND RESPONSE FOR CHILDREN
snippet: Around 80 per cent of deaths due to mpox are among children. The mpox outbreak also has the potential to cause other harms to children, such as secondary infections, as well as stigma in communities. There are two clades of the virus. In 2022–2023 a global outbreak of mpox was caused by clade 2.
